tool_args.rationale: All pilot measurements are positive and end by H = 0.48. The targeted long-horizon probe tests whether that positive response reverses and constrains the slow component before forecasting at H = 24.3.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows constrain early gain but do not reliably separate the slow amplitude from its time constant, which matters at H = 24.3.
All pilot rows have s_grad = 0, so the sink coefficient is unidentifiable; input and horizon also rise together, obscuring input saturation.
At x_now = 0, this model bounds |y| by |u_now|, which the final pilot row exceeds.
Finer sampling is less directly informative about the slow component than observations at a longer horizon.
